summary: This directory contains structural analysis logic for decomposing complex TypeScript type nodes into their constituent components, enabling the extraction of detailed type definitions and structure representations from source code ASTs.
responsibilities: Decompose complex TypeScript type nodes into semantic structures
Extract internal type components such as constraints, modifiers, and members
Resolve module specifiers and source path references for imported types
Support the recursive analysis of nested type structures
relationships: Analyzers recursively decompose complex type nodes into smaller, more granular type structures.
Module specifiers are resolved and normalized to correlate imported types with their underlying project-relative source files.
designDecisions: Functional decomposition of type node analysis into isolated handler functions
Recursive traversal approach for handling nested type definitions
Standardized extraction of properties, modifiers, and type constraints across various node types
